title: Competition and Corruption: Highway Corruption in West Africa
Impact of climate smart agriculture on food security: an agent based analysis
abstract: The study proposes an agent-based model to investigate how adoption of climate smart agriculture (CSA) affects food security. The analysis investigates the role of social and ecological pressures (i.e. community network, climate change and environmental externalities) on the adoption of physical water and soil practices as well as crop rotation technique. The findings reveal that CSA may be an effective strategy to improve the rural populations' well-being for farm households with access to capital, strong social networks and access to integrated food markets. The climate scenario simulations indicate that farmers adopting CSA fare better than non-adopters, although CSA adoption does not fully counterbalance the severe climate pressures. In addition, farmers with poor connections to food markets benefit less from CSA due to stronger price oscillations. These results call for an active role for policy makers in encouraging adaptation through CSA adoption by increasing access to capital, improving food market integration and building social networks.
abstract_zh: 本研究提出一个基于主体的模型，以考察采用气候智能型农业（CSA）如何影响粮食安全。分析考察了社会和生态压力（即社区网络、气候变化和环境外部性）对采用物理水土措施以及轮作技术的影响。研究结果表明，对于能够获得资本、拥有强大社会网络并可进入一体化粮食市场的农户而言，气候智能型农业可能是改善农村人口福祉的有效策略。气候情景模拟表明，采用CSA的农民比未采用者境况更好，但CSA的采用并不能完全抵消严峻的气候压力。此外，与粮食市场联系较差的农民从CSA中获益较少，因为他们面临更强的价格波动。这些结果呼吁政策制定者发挥积极作用，通过增加资本获取、改善粮食市场一体化以及构建社会网络，鼓励农户通过采用CSA实现适应。

Effectiveness of local regulations on nonpoint source pollution: Evidence from Wisconsin dairy farms
abstract: Although the Clean Water Act's regulation of point source pollution has had a significant effect on water quality, nonpoint sources of pollution, especially animal agriculture, remain a leading unevenly regulated source of water pollution in the United States. This work studies the effectiveness of local manure management regulations on dairy farms in Wisconsin. Wisconsin represents a unique policy experiment in the delegation of nonpoint agricultural pollution policy in a state with economically important small, nonpoint, dairy farms. Using hand collected regulatory data from Wisconsin counties we estimate the effects of changes in local regulations on water quality outcomes. The results demonstrate that a few easily implemented and verifiable regulations such as nutrient management plans have significant short‐term effects on water quality, whereas other less observable and difficult to implement regulations have no discernible effects in the short term. The work points to a number of potential policy levers to improve the Management of nonpoint pollution, as well as the challenges of nonpoint source regulatory policies on slow‐moving hydrologic processes.
abstract_zh: 尽管《清洁水法》对点源污染的监管对水质产生了重大影响，但非点源污染，尤其是动物养殖业带来的污染，仍是美国水污染中一个主要的、监管不均衡的来源。本研究考察了威斯康星州奶牛场地方粪肥管理法规的有效性。威斯康星州是一个经济上重要且以小规模非点源奶牛场为主的州，它代表了在非点源农业污染政策方面进行权力下放的独特政策实验。我们利用从威斯康星州各县手工收集的监管数据，估计了地方法规变化对水质结果的影响。结果表明，少数易于实施和核查的法规（如养分管理计划）在短期内对水质有显著影响，而其他较难观察和实施的法规在短期内则未见明显效果。本研究指出了改善非点源污染管理的若干潜在政策杠杆，以及非点源监管政策在应对缓慢变化的水文过程方面所面临的挑战。

Academic Engagement, Commercialization, and Scholarship: Empirical Evidence from Agricultural and Life Scientists at US Land Grant Universities
venue: Economics of Research and Innovation in Agriculture
abstract: This article examines the involvement of agricultural and life science faculty at U.S. land grant universities in two types of university-industry relations: academic engagement (sponsored research, industry collaborations, and presentations), academic commercialization (patenting, licensing, and start-ups) and traditional academic scholarship. It exploits large-scale, random sample cross-section surveys of nearly 1,500 scientists at the original 52 Land Grant Universities in 2005 and 2015. We fill a knowledge gap regarding the prevalence, coincidence, intensity, importance and factors shaping faculty involvement in university-industry relations (UIR). After several decades of promotion and emphasis on UIR activities participation in them has plateaued and is stable at a fairly high level. Academic engagement is far more prevalent (at 76% of faculty) and important than is academic commercialization (at 19% of faculty). Academic engagement generates 15-20 times the research funds than academic commercialization does, but both continue to be dwarfed by public funding. We find evidence of synergies between UIR activities and academic scholarship. We also explore how individual, institutional, and university-level factors help explain faculty UIR participation. We find differences across academic disciplines and highlight the role that faculty attitudes toward science and commercial activity shape involvement in UIR. Significant differences also stem from university level effects and may be contingent on culture, history, location, and quality of science.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国赠地大学（land grant universities）农业和生命科学教员参与两类校企关系的情况：学术参与（委托研究、产业合作和学术报告）、学术商业化（专利、许可和初创企业），以及传统学术研究。本文利用2005年和2015年对最初52所赠地大学近1,500名科学家进行的大规模随机抽样截面调查。我们填补了一项知识空白，即教员参与校企关系（UIR）的普遍程度、并存情况、强度、重要性及其影响因素。经过数十年对校企关系活动的推动与强调，教员的参与已趋于平稳，并保持在较高水平。学术参与远比学术商业化普遍（76%的教员参与）且更为重要（学术商业化仅19%的教员参与）。学术参与带来的研究经费是学术商业化的15–20倍，但两者均远不及公共资金。我们发现校企关系活动与学术研究之间存在协同效应。我们还探讨了个人、机构和大学层面的因素如何解释教员参与校企关系的情况。我们发现不同学科之间存在差异，并强调了教员对科学和商业活动的态度在塑造其参与校企关系方面的作用。大学层面的效应也带来显著差异，这可能取决于文化、历史、地理位置以及科学质量。

title: Lineage Networks, Urban Migration and Income Inequality: Evidence from Rural China
Vulnerability of sorghum production to extreme, sub-seasonal weather under climate change
abstract: In the tropics, extreme weather associated with global climate teleconnections can have an outsized impact on food security. In Ethiopia, the El Niño Southern Oscillation (ENSO) is frequently linked to drought-induced food insecurity. Many projections hold that El Niño events will become more frequent or more intense under climate change, suggesting that El Niño associated droughts may become more destructive. Agricultural vulnerability to extremes under climate change, however, is a function of exposure, sensitivity, and adaptive capacity. Sensitivity, in this context, can depend on sub-seasonal distribution of rainfall. This paper investigates crop sensitivity to sub-seasonal rainfall variability under climate change in a food insecure area of the Ethiopian highlands through analysis of process-oriented crop model results for the years 1981–2100 driven by 14 GCMs chosen for the ability to represent ENSO and rainfall characteristics of the study area. Further, adaptive capacity in the region is investigated with in-depth interviews and focus groups concerning the 2015 strong El Niño event. Crop model results for sorghum highlight that exposure and sensitivity to sub-seasonal extremes of low rainfall can diverge significantly from sorghum's response to seasonal drought. Even though climate change will bring generally warmer and wetter seasons to the study area, there is an increased occurrence of sub-seasonal failure of rains early in the rainy season which will likely have negative impacts on sorghum yield. In-depth interviews show that biophysical constraints significantly reduce farmer adaptive capacity to this type of sub-seasonal extreme. This work highlights the need to consider sub-seasonal weather when assessing climate change threats to agriculture, particularly for subsistence farmers in the developing world.
abstract_zh: 在热带地区，与全球气候遥相关相联系的极端天气可能对粮食安全产生不成比例的影响。在埃塞俄比亚，厄尔尼诺–南方涛动（ENSO）常与干旱引发的粮食不安全相联系。许多预测认为，在气候变化下厄尔尼诺事件将变得更频繁或更强烈，这表明与厄尔尼诺相关的干旱可能会变得更具破坏性。然而，气候变化下的农业脆弱性是暴露度、敏感性和适应能力的函数。在此背景下，敏感性可能取决于降雨的次季节分布。本文通过分析1981–2100年过程导向型作物模型的结果，考察了气候变化下埃塞俄比亚高地一个粮食不安全地区作物对次季节降雨变化的敏感性。这些模型由14个GCM驱动，选择它们的依据是其能够刻画研究区域的ENSO和降雨特征。此外，我们通过深度访谈和焦点小组，考察了该地区应对2015年强厄尔尼诺事件的适应能力。高粱的作物模型结果表明，高粱对次季节性低降雨极端事件的暴露度和敏感性，可能与其对季节性干旱的反应存在显著差异。尽管气候变化将使研究区域的季节总体上变得更温暖、更湿润，但雨季早期出现次季节性降雨失败的情况会增加，这很可能对高粱产量产生负面影响。深度访谈表明，生物物理约束显著降低了农民应对此类次季节性极端事件的适应能力。这项工作强调，在评估气候变化对农业的威胁时需要考虑次季节天气，尤其是对发展中国家的自给农户而言。

The Sahel's Silent Maize Revolution: Analyzing Maize Productivity in Mali at the Farm-level
abstract: Since independence a quiet revolution has taken place in maize production in the Sahel with Mali increasing production more than ten-fold and yields going up ~2% a year. This research work uses farm level panel data from southern Mali's maize growing regions to demonstrate this success in agricultural production and technological change. We analyze the determinants of production to unpack increases in input use from technological change. The estimations show that farmer adoption of increased fertilizer use has driven much of the productivity growth rather than the adoption of improvements in seeds and management. Additionally, we find strong evidence of observed and unobserved heterogeneity, which affects both the choice of fertilizer amounts and the marginal returns to fertilizer use. The results demonstrate the key changes behind this silent maize revolution and point to the importance of taking into account farmer heterogeneity in estimating productivity and returns to fertilizer.
abstract_zh: 自独立以来，萨赫勒地区的玉米生产发生了一场悄然的革命：马里的产量增长了十多倍，单产每年提高约2%。本研究利用马里南部玉米产区的农场层面面板数据，证明了这一农业生产与技术变革方面的成功。我们分析生产的决定因素，以揭示投入使用增加中由技术变革带来的部分。估计结果表明，农民采用更多化肥是生产率增长的主要驱动因素，而非种子和管理方面改进的采用。此外，我们发现有力证据表明存在可观测和不可观测的异质性，它既影响化肥施用量的选择，也影响化肥的边际回报。研究结果揭示了这场“悄然的玉米革命”背后的关键变化，并指出在估计生产率和化肥回报时考虑农户异质性的重要性。

title: Unintended Consequences of Sanctions for Human Rights: Conflict Minerals and Infant Mortality
abstract: Are victims of human rights abuses better off with or without economic sanctions targeted at their perpetrators? We study this question in the context of a US human rights policy, the conflict-minerals section of the 2010 Dodd-Frank Act. By discouraging companies from sourcing tin, tungsten, and tantalum from the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the policy has acted as a de facto boycott on mineral purchases that may finance warlords and armed militias. We estimate the policy’s impact on the mortality of children born before 2013 and find that it increased the probability of infant deaths in villages near the policy-targeted mines by at least 143 percent. We find suggestive evidence that the legislation-induced boycott did so by reducing mothers’ consumption of infant health care goods and services.
abstract_zh: 对于人权侵害的受害者而言，针对施害者的经济制裁究竟是让他们的处境变好还是变坏？我们在美国一项人权政策的背景下研究这一问题，即2010年《多德－弗兰克法案》中的冲突矿产条款。该政策阻止企业从刚果民主共和国东部采购锡、钨和钽，实际上对可能资助军阀和武装民兵的矿产采购形成了事实上的抵制。我们估计了该政策对2013年前出生儿童死亡率的影响，发现其使政策所针对矿区附近村庄的婴儿死亡概率至少提高了143%。我们发现有一定证据表明，立法引发的抵制是通过减少母亲对婴儿保健用品和服务的消费而造成上述结果的。

title: Agroecosystem-specific climate vulnerability analysis: application of the livelihood vulnerability index to a tropical highland region
venue: Mitigation and Adaptation Strategies for Global Change
abstract: In topographically diverse highland terrain, socio-economic and environmental conditions can vary dramatically over relatively short distances. This presents a challenge for climate resilient development strategies, as exposure to climate variability and change, climate impacts, and adaptive capacity differ between communities located within common cultural and administrative units. The Livelihood Vulnerability Index (LVI) framed within the United Nations Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) vulnerability framework (LVI-IPCC) offers a tool to assess climate vulnerability through direct household surveys. This makes it particularly appropriate for analyses at sub-community and community scales. Here we apply the LVI-IPCC to communities of Choke Mountain, located in the Blue Nile Highlands of Ethiopia. Recognizing the physiographic and climatic diversity that exists in this mountainous environment, we implement LVI-IPCC analysis for 793 mixed crop-livestock farming households using the five distinct agroecological systems (AES) that compose the populated area of Choke Mountain as a framework for analysis. For each AES, an LVI index, adaptive capacity metric, and LVI-IPCC vulnerability score was calculated. We found that each of these metrics varied systematically across AES. High elevation sloping lands and low elevation steep lands exhibited relatively low adaptive capacity and high vulnerability while midland AES had higher capacity and lower vulnerability. These results suggest that resilience building interventions for Choke Mountain ecosystems should be targeted to address the specific circumstances of each AES. The approach of applying LVI-IPCC at AES scale could be applicable to other climate vulnerable mountainous regions.
abstract_zh: 在地形多样的高地地区，社会经济和环境条件在相对较短的距离内可能差异巨大。这对气候韧性发展战略构成挑战，因为在共享同一文化和行政单位的社区之间，气候变率与变化的暴露度、气候影响以及适应能力各不相同。联合国政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）脆弱性框架下的生计脆弱性指数（LVI-IPCC）提供了一种通过直接住户调查评估气候脆弱性的工具，这使其特别适用于亚社区和社区尺度的分析。在此，我们将LVI-IPCC应用于埃塞俄比亚青尼罗高地（Blue Nile Highlands）的乔克山（Choke Mountain）社区。鉴于这一山区环境存在的地貌与气候多样性，我们以构成乔克山有人居住区域的五个不同农业生态系统（AES）作为分析框架，对793户混合种植–养殖农户实施了LVI-IPCC分析。对于每个AES，我们计算了LVI指数、适应能力指标和LVI-IPCC脆弱性得分。我们发现，这些指标在各AES之间均呈系统性变化。高海拔坡地和低海拔陡地的适应能力相对较低、脆弱性较高，而中部地带的AES适应能力较高、脆弱性较低。这些结果表明，针对乔克山生态系统的韧性建设干预措施应针对每个AES的具体情况。在山区尺度上应用LVI-IPCC的方法，也可能适用于其他气候脆弱的山区。

title: Cotton as Catalyst?: The Role of Shifting Fertilizer in Mali's Silent Maize Revolution
Making Time for Agricultural and Life Science Research: Technical Change and Productivity Gains
abstract: This work analyzes the research productivity of agricultural and life science faculty in U.S. Land Grant research universities from 1975 to 2005. Production function estimations that control for inputs and demographic characteristics reveal significant improvements after 1980 in faculty research productivity per unit time, especially in the non‐top ten universities. Because, however, time available to faculty for research has decreased substantially in the past three decades, overall journal article output per faculty did not increase after the 1980s. Our findings demonstrate large productivity increases but raise concerns about the optimal allocation of faculty time.
abstract_zh: 本研究分析了1975至2005年间美国赠地研究型大学农业和生命科学教员的研究生产率。控制投入和人口特征的生产函数估计显示，1980年以后，教员单位时间的研究生产率显著提高，尤其是在非前十大高校中。然而，由于过去三十年间教员可用于研究的时间大幅减少，每位教员的期刊论文总产出在1980年代之后并未增加。我们的研究结果表明生产率大幅提升，但也引发了关于教员时间最优分配的担忧。

title: Making Time for Science
Rice, Irrigation and Downside Risk: A Quantile Analysis of Risk Exposure and Mitigation on Korean Farms
abstract: This article develops a quantile moment approach to evaluate risk exposure and to illustrate risk valuation, and then applies it to examine the relative importance of downside risk and risk mitigation options associated with a highly controlled but stochastic production system on Korean farms. The econometric approach exploits a rich panel dataset to develop consistent and robust econometric estimates of the quantile moments needed to decompose and analyse risk outcomes. The results show that about 90 per cent of the cost of risk on Korean farms comes from exposure to downside risk. We also examine how management factors can help to mitigate risk exposure outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种分位数矩方法来评估风险暴露并阐释风险估值，并将其应用于考察韩国农场中一个高度可控但具有随机性的生产系统所面临的下行风险，以及风险缓解选项的相对重要性。计量经济方法利用丰富的面板数据集，开发出分位数矩的一致且稳健的计量估计，用以分解和分析风险结果。结果表明，韩国农场约90%的风险成本来自下行风险暴露。我们还考察了管理因素如何帮助缓解风险暴露结果。

Building climate resilience in the Blue Nile / Abay Highlands: A role for Earth System Sciences
venue: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
abstract: The Blue Nile (Abay) Highlands of Ethiopia are characterized by significant interannual climate variability, complex topography and associated local climate contrasts, erosive rains and erodible soils, and intense land pressure due to an increasing population and an economy that is almost entirely dependent on smallholder, low-input agriculture. As a result, these highland zones are highly vulnerable to negative impacts of climate variability. As patterns of variability and precipitation intensity alter under anthropogenic climate change, there is concern that this vulnerability will increase, threatening economic development and food security in the region. In order to overcome these challenges and to enhance sustainable development in the context of climate change, it is necessary to establish climate resilient development strategies that are informed by best-available Earth System Science (ESS) information. This requirement is complicated by the fact that climate projections for the Abay Highlands contain significant and perhaps irreducible uncertainties. A critical challenge for ESS, then, is to generate and to communicate meaningful information for climate resilient development in the context of a highly uncertain climate forecast. Here we report on a framework for applying ESS to climate resilient development in the Abay Highlands, with a focus on the challenge of reducing land degradation.
abstract_zh: 埃塞俄比亚的青尼罗河（Abay）高地具有显著的年际气候变率、复杂的地形及由此产生的局地气候反差、侵蚀性降雨和易侵蚀土壤，且人口增长带来的土地压力巨大，其经济几乎完全依赖小农户的低投入农业。因此，这些高地地区极易受到气候变率负面影响的冲击。随着人为气候变化改变变率格局和降水强度，人们担心这种脆弱性将进一步加剧，从而威胁该地区的经济发展与粮食安全。为克服这些挑战并在气候变化背景下促进可持续发展，有必要制定以现有最佳地球系统科学（ESS）信息为依据的气候韧性发展战略。由于Abay高地的气候预测包含显著且或许不可消除的不确定性，这一要求变得更加复杂。因此，地球系统科学面临的一项关键挑战，是在高度不确定的气候预测背景下，生成并传递对气候韧性发展有意义的信息。在此，我们报告了一个将地球系统科学应用于Abay高地气候韧性发展的框架，重点关注减少土地退化的挑战。

title: Early Adoption, Experience, and Farm Performance of GM Corn Seeds
abstract: The current article explores the characteristics that distinguish early from late adopters of GM corn and measures the productivity impacts of early adoption, for a sample of farmers in Minnesota and Wisconsin. The results of the adoption analysis confirm that size, education as well as specialization are positively correlated with early adoption. In addition, these results also show that farms that are mostly worked by family labor but hire some off‐farm labor are more likely to adopt GM seeds earlier in the diffusion process. The productivity analysis demonstrates the superiority of stacked varieties. At the same time, we find no evidence of a direct impact of experience on yields. Given the previously documented impact of early adoption on the use of stacked varieties, we conclude that experience plays a role through the adoption of these new technologies but does not play a role in allowing the producer to use the technology more efficiently, once it has been adopted.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了区分转基因玉米早期采用者与晚期采用者的特征，并测度早期采用的生产率影响，样本为明尼苏达州和威斯康星州的农户。采用分析结果证实，农场规模、教育水平以及生产专业化程度均与早期采用呈正相关。此外，这些结果还表明，主要依靠家庭劳动力但雇用部分场外劳动力的农场，在扩散过程中更有可能较早采用转基因种子。生产率分析显示了叠加性状品种（stacked varieties）的优越性。与此同时，我们没有发现经验对单产有直接影响的证据。鉴于此前已记录的早期采用对叠加性状品种使用的影响，我们得出结论：经验通过新技术的采用发挥作用，但在技术被采用之后，并不能帮助生产者更有效地使用该技术。

title: Efficiency and Technological Change at US Research Universities
Specialization, Diversification, and Productivity: A Panel Data Analysis of Rice Farms in Korea
abstract: This article examines the microeconomics of productivity associated with specialization/diversification in production activities, with an application to Korean rice farms. Korean rice farms tend to be very small and highly specialized. Our analysis examines the productivity effects associated with both farm size and farm specialization/diversification in Korean agriculture. Relying on farm‐level panel data, the analysis studies farm productivity in a multi‐input multi‐output context, accounting not only for changes in inputs and technical change in rice production, but also for the role of diversification in the production of other crops in current and previous periods. We find positive but small productivity gains from farm diversification. These gains come mostly from complementarity effects across farm outputs, with minimal effect of scale economies. The positive complementarity effects work against nonconvexity effects, which provide strong productivity incentives for rice farms to specialize.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了与生产活动专业化/多元化相关的生产率微观经济学，并以韩国稻米农场为应用对象。韩国稻米农场往往规模很小且高度专业化。我们的分析考察了韩国农业中农场规模和农场专业化/多元化两方面的生产率效应。基于农场层面的面板数据，本分析在多投入多产出框架下研究农场生产率，不仅考虑了稻米生产中投入的变化和技术进步，还考虑了当期和以前时期其他作物多元化生产的作用。我们发现，农场多元化带来了正向但较小的生产率增益。这些增益主要来自农场产出之间的互补效应，规模经济的影响微乎其微。正向的互补效应与非凸性效应相抵消，后者为稻米农场提供了强烈的专业化生产率激励。

title: Plant Scientists and the Productivity Effects of Extension Appointments
Sequential Adoption of Package Technologies: Dynamics of Stacked Trait Corn Adoption
Sustainability Under Siege: Transport Costs and Corruption on West Africa's Trade Corridors
abstract: We use recent data on transport costs in West Africa, including the added burden of bribes and enforced delays, to show how such costs represent a deterrent to investment in — and therefore the sustainability of — agricultural assets. We focus on data for two important tree crops in West Africa, cashew and shea. We also have data for the transport of onions between Niger and the urban market in Accra, Ghana. Our data allow us to predict plausible increases in farm-gate prices from a reduction in transport costs and bribes. A 10% reduction in the total transport costs (actual costs plus corruption costs) of onions from Niger could result in a 12-13% price increase to onion farmers. Similar elasticities are 2% for cashew in Ghana and 7% for shea in Mali. These feasible price increases would encourage farmers to improve onion production, and to protect and improve production from cashew and shea trees, thereby enhancing the sustainability of agro-forestry in West Africa. We call these price increases the “sustainability dividend”.
abstract_zh: 我们利用西非近期的运输成本数据，包括贿赂和强制延误所增加的负担，说明此类成本如何构成对农业资产投资的阻碍，进而威胁其可持续性。我们聚焦西非两种重要的经济林木作物：腰果和乳木果（shea）。我们还掌握了尼日尔与加纳阿克拉（Accra）城市市场之间洋葱运输的数据。这些数据使我们能够预测，运输成本和贿赂降低可能带来的农场门口价格上涨。将尼日尔洋葱的总运输成本（实际成本加腐败成本）降低10%，可能使洋葱农民的价格上涨12–13%。加纳腰果和马里乳木果的类似弹性分别为2%和7%。这些可行的价格上涨将激励农民改善洋葱生产，并保护和改善腰果及乳木果树的生产，从而增强西非农林业的可持续性。我们将这些价格上涨称为“可持续性红利”。

The Adoption and Impact of Management Intensive Rotational Grazing (MIRG) on Connecticut Dairy Farms
abstract: Management intensive rotational grazing (MIRG) has garnered a great deal of interest in recent years as a method for returning profitability to Northeastern dairy farms. This work uses a random sample of Connecticut dairy farmers to estimate a binary choice adoption model and then cost, productivity, and profit functions that control for the adoption choice. MIRG adopters are shown to be more educated and have less rented agricultural land (a proxy for lack of access to land within a short distance of the barn). MIRG adoption had no significant effects on costs and productivity, nor did it lower profits, per cow. Evidence was found, however, to suggest that full adopters of the technology had more profitable farms than partial adopters. These results also show the importance of controlling for the different characteristics of adopters when evaluating the returns to animal grazing.
abstract_zh: 管理密集型轮牧（MIRG）近年来作为一种恢复东北部奶牛场盈利能力的方法，引起了广泛关注。本研究使用康涅狄格州奶农的随机样本，估计了一个二元选择采用模型，以及控制采用选择的成本、生产率和利润函数。结果显示，MIRG采用者受教育程度更高，且租用的农地较少（这是缺乏在距牛棚较近范围内获得土地的代理变量）。采用MIRG对成本和生产率没有显著影响，也没有降低每头奶牛的利润。然而，有证据表明，全面采用该技术的农场比部分采用者更有利可图。这些结果还表明，在评估动物放牧的回报时，控制采用者的不同特征至关重要。

title: The Role of Community and Farm Characteristics in Farm Input Purchasing Patterns
abstract: This work uses unique data from three dairy-dependent communities in rural Wisconsin to test established theory and empirical studies that link farm structure to local purchasing patterns. A theoretical model of purchasing choices is developed to derive the demand determinants of local purchasing. This model is tested empirically across eleven major dairy farm inputs using a double-bounded Tobit model that also includes community characteristics. The empirical estimations find little support for a general linkage between farm-level characteristics and local purchasing patterns. The results do suggest that different community characteristics provide some explanations for diverse purchasing patterns.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用威斯康星州农村三个以奶牛业为主的社区的独特数据，检验了将农场结构与当地采购模式联系起来的既有理论和实证研究。我们建立了一个采购选择的理论模型，以推导当地采购的需求决定因素。该模型利用包含社区特征的双边界Tobit模型，在十一种主要奶牛场投入品上进行了实证检验。实证估计几乎没有发现农场层面特征与当地采购模式之间存在一般性关联的证据。结果确实表明，不同的社区特征可以为多样化的采购模式提供一些解释。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Recombinant Bovine Somatotropin Adoption Across Major U.S. Dairy Regions
Credit Market Access and Profitability in Tunisian Agriculture
abstract: This work develops an econometric model that links credit access with agricultural profitability and investment. Using data collected from rural Tunisia, this work provides direct estimates of credit access and its effects. Econometric estimates are run for agricultural investment and profitability as a function of credit access. The investigation of credit access and its effect suggests that the presence of credit market constraints does impinge significantly on farm profitability, but not on investments.
abstract_zh: 本研究建立了一个计量经济模型，将信贷可得性与农业盈利能力和投资联系起来。利用在突尼斯农村收集的数据，本研究直接估计了信贷可得性及其效应。我们对农业投资和盈利能力作为信贷可得性函数进行了计量估计。对信贷可得性及其效应的考察表明，信贷市场约束的存在确实对农场盈利能力产生了显著影响，但对投资没有显著影响。

title: Entry, Exit, and Farm Size: Assessing an Experiment in Dairy Price Policy
abstract: This article models and estimates the forces behind farm exits and changes in herd‐size among Connecticut dairy farms under the New England Dairy Compact. A model of sunk costs and farm capital investment is used to specify two econometric estimations: a random effects probit model of farm entry and exit and an autocorrelated generalized least squares panel data model of farm size. The Dairy Compact's price strategy reduced farm exits and moderately increased cow numbers. In contrast, development pressures and historically low unemployment rates increased farm exits.
abstract_zh: 本文建模并估计了新英格兰乳制品协议（New England Dairy Compact）下，康涅狄格州奶牛场退出和牛群规模变化背后的驱动力。我们利用包含沉没成本和农场资本投资的模型，设定了两个计量估计：农场进入与退出的随机效应概率（probit）模型，以及农场规模的自相关广义最小二乘面板数据模型。乳制品协议的价格策略减少了农场退出，并适度增加了奶牛数量。相比之下，开发压力和历史上的低失业率则增加了农场退出。

title: The Dynamics of Agricultural Biotechnology Adoption: Lessons from rBST use in Wisconsin, 1994-2001
abstract: This article exploits panel data from Wisconsin dairy farmers to examine the dynamics of recombinant bovine somatotropin (rBST) adoption and to identify the characteristics that distinguish among nonadopters, disadopters, and early and late adopters. Panel methods are used to control for omitted variables and endogenous regressors that call into question coefficient estimates derived from cross-section adoption models. The results, however, confirm previous findings that larger farms with complementary feeding technologies are more likely to adopt rBST, nonadopters appear quite unlikely to become adopters, and rBST adoption will remain at rather moderate levels in Wisconsin. Copyright 2004, Oxford University Press.
abstract_zh: 本文利用威斯康星州奶农的面板数据，考察重组牛生长激素（rBST）采用的动态过程，并识别区分未采用者、弃用者以及早期与晚期采用者的特征。采用面板方法以控制遗漏变量和内生解释变量，这些问题使得横截面采用模型的系数估计存疑。然而，结果证实了先前的发现：规模较大且拥有互补饲养技术的农场更可能采用rBST，未采用者几乎不太可能转变为采用者，而且rBST的采用在威斯康星州将维持在较为适中的水平。版权所有2004，牛津大学出版社。

title: A Dynamic Analysis of University Agricultural Biotechnology Patent Production
abstract: This article examines the factors that account for agricultural biotechnology patenting success among universities using a dynamic count data model. It builds a theoretical and econometric model to capture the inherently dynamic and nonlinear process of technological innovation, wherein a feedback mechanism from previous success partially determines current patent counts. The econometric estimates reveal the importance to agricultural biotechnology patent production of land grant infrastructure, quality faculty, patent‐oriented technology transfer offices, as well as dynamic feedback effects.
abstract_zh: 本文利用动态计数数据模型，考察了大学在农业生物技术专利申请方面取得成功的影响因素。它构建了理论和计量模型，以刻画技术创新固有的动态非线性过程，其中先前的成功通过反馈机制部分决定了当前的专利数量。计量估计揭示了赠地大学基础设施、高水平教员、以专利为导向的技术转移办公室以及动态反馈效应对农业生物技术专利生产的重要性。

Do Purchasing Patterns Differ Between Large and Small Dairy Farms? Econometric Evidence From Three Wisconsin Communities
abstract: Using farm data from three dairy-dependent communities in Wisconsin, this study addresses the question: Do small farms spend more locally than large farms? The work develops a theoretical model of farm cost functions with transaction costs varying between local and distant input sources. This model is then tested econometrically, describing farm costs and where they were spent as a function of transaction/search costs and farm characteristics. The results suggest that scale does matter to farm spending patterns.
abstract_zh: 利用威斯康星州三个以奶牛业为主的社区的农场数据，本研究探讨了一个问题：小型农场在当地的消费是否多于大型农场？本研究建立了一个农场成本函数的理论模型，其中本地与远程投入来源的交易成本各不相同。随后对该模型进行了计量检验，将农场成本及其支出地点描述为交易/搜寻成本和农场特征的函数。结果表明，规模确实影响农场的支出模式。

title: The Adoption and Profitability of rBST on Connecticut Dairy Farms
abstract: This work estimates probit and tobit models of the adoption of recombinant bovine somatotropin (rbST) on Connecticut dairy farms and then endogenizes that adoption in estimates of milk production and farm profit rates. The work improves on the current literature by allowing the rbST decision to be both continuous and contingent on other technology adoption decisions. The results show that larger farms, with more productivity technologies, and with younger, more educated farmers, are more likely to adopt rbST. While rbST is shown to significantly increase milk production, there is no evidence that it increases profits on a per cow basis.
abstract_zh: 本研究估计了康涅狄格州奶牛场采用重组牛生长激素（rbST）的概率（probit）模型和托宾（tobit）模型，然后将这一采用决策内生化于牛奶产量和农场利润率的估计之中。本研究的改进之处在于，允许rbST的决策既是连续的，又取决于其他技术的采用决策。结果表明，规模较大、拥有更多生产力技术、且农场主更年轻、受教育程度更高的农场，更可能采用rbST。虽然rbST显著提高了牛奶产量，但没有证据表明它能按每头奶牛计提高利润。
